content:
Context: 10. Authorization of Pension and Gratuity

[ Swamy's -  
Pension Compilation ]  
1. Issue of PPO and authority for payment of gratuity.The Accounts Officer responsible for issue of Pension Payment Order, on receipt of pension papers from the Head of Office, shall apply necessary checks, record the account enfacement and assess the amount of pension and gratuity and issue the Pension Payment Order not later than two months in advance of the date of retirement on superannuation of the Government servant.
